title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 9 full-slate certification
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: Steps 1-8 repaired individual contracts, but there was no final 10/10 gate proving every ranked card and every expanded detail together, and the obsolete audit footer could surface as raw markup in the customer UI.
root_cause: The project lacked one end-to-end certifier spanning card identity/logos, research completeness, terminal history, benefits/risks, provenance/fallback truth, responsive presentation contracts, and raw-HTML cleanliness.
patch: Add a Step-9 full-slate live certifier, final detail/page/router wrappers, history-attempt provenance closeout, and a customer-facing cleanup that removes the obsolete audit footer now superseded by Sources + Freshness.

base_drift_compatibility_patch.root_cause: Main advanced after Step-9 branch creation and the active app router moved from the CFB Step-8 wrapper to WNBA PRA Speed V3 Step 4, which itself delegates through CFB Step 8.
base_drift_compatibility_patch.patch: Preserve WNBA Speed Step 4 as the current parent and temporarily substitute only cfb_step8_parent.TOP_PICKS_PAGE with cfb_top_picks_page_v9 during render.

authoritative_failure_repair.exact_failure: tests/test_wnba_pra_speed_v3_step4.py::test_step4_activation_is_wired required the frozen WNBA Step-4 import string to remain present in app.py source.
authoritative_failure_repair.root_cause: Step-9 correctly delegated through WNBA Step 4 at runtime, but app.py no longer contained the exact source-compatibility import string expected by the frozen WNBA contract.
authoritative_failure_repair.patch: Add the exact WNBA Step-4 import string as a frozen compatibility comment while leaving the active runtime import on Step 9.

merged_main_test_repair.original_failure: Step-9 full-slate test contained literal \\n sequences and stale router aliases, causing pytest collection SyntaxError.
merged_main_test_repair.repair: Replace literal escape text with real Python newlines and assert current_parent/cfb_step8_parent aliases.
merged_main_test_repair.control_plane_failure: The one-file repair PR changed no task ledger, so action_ledger_v2 correctly rejected it.
merged_main_test_repair.control_plane_patch: Update this existing Step-9 task ledger as the exactly-one changed task ledger required for a non-documentation repair PR.
